breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly sets up the bending moment as a linearly varying function M(x) = P(L − x) for 0 ≤ x ≤ L, rather than using the constant peak value M = PL over the full span. It then integrates M(x)^2/(2EI) and differentiates with respect to P, yielding the correct result δ = PL^3/(3EI) = 1.125 mm. This directly fixes the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt incorrectly used a constant peak moment.
